name: ai-engineering-experts
description: Routes 14 production engineering skills - requirements grilling, cross-model adversarial review, iOS/macOS engineering, cognitive reasoning discipline and project decision evaluation - into one orchestrated workflow.

display_description.zh: 聚合十四个工程化技能：需求盘问锁定、跨模型对抗审查、iOS 全栈工程、认知论证纪律、项目决策评估，按场景路由、逐层加载。
display_description.en: One expert carrying 14 production engineering skills: requirements grilling, cross-model adversarial review, iOS/macOS engineering, cognitive reasoning discipline and project decision evaluation, routed per scenario and loaded layer by layer.

default_init_prompt.zh: 帮我盘问清楚这个需求再动手
default_init_prompt.en: Grill this requirement before you start building

quick_prompts.zh: 帮我盘问清楚这个需求再动手
quick_prompts.en: Grill this requirement before you start building

quick_prompts.zh: 审查本次改动并给出根因
quick_prompts.en: Review this change and give the root cause

agent.name: ai-engineering-expert
agent.description: Orchestrator that routes each request to one of 14 production engineering skills and loads their full rule text before acting.

notes.skills: 专家包内 14 个技能同处 skills/ 下，跨技能链接（如 ../../cognitive-reasoning/references/...）天然可解析，因此不做依赖内联；技能包才需要内联。
notes.team: 改 expert_type 为 team 时，需要补 team_info{leadAgent, memberAgents} 并为每个成员在 workbuddy/templates/ 下准备同名 Agent 定义。
notes.avatar_source: 源图在 workbuddy/avatars/expert.png（512×512 PNG），构建时复制进包；缺失才回退到脚本生成的渐变占位图。
